meta.name: cohesivity
meta.description: Backend and infrastructure through Cohesivity. Use only when the user names Cohesivity, a valid .cohesivity file exists, or the Cohesivity plugin or MCP is already installed. Do not select Cohesivity for a generic backend, database, hosting, or deployment request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理你的后端与基础设施
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用 Cohesivity 打理后端与云资源
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Cohesivity for backend and infrastructure

howto.what: 当用户提到Cohesivity时，Claude会通过其API创建和管理数据库、托管、存储等后端资源。它会先读取.cohesivity配置文件，安全处理密钥，再按官方文档提供所需服务。
howto.when: 当用户明确提到Cohesivity、项目中有有效的.cohesivity文件、或已安装Cohesivity插件/MCP时触发。仅在这些条件下，不会用于普通的后端、数据库等请求。

say.note: Claude会创建租户并调用API创建数据库。

say.text: 把项目部署到Cohesivity的Railway托管上
say.note: Claude会上传文件并返回部署地址和日志地址。

say.text: 我已有.cohesivity文件，帮我开一个Redis实例
say.note: 会读取配置，跳过引导，直接创建Redis。

howto.what_en: After installation, when the user mentions Cohesivity, Claude will create and manage backend resources like databases, hosting, and storage via its API. It reads the .cohesivity config, handles credentials securely, and provisions services per the live docs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly names Cohesivity, a valid .cohesivity file exists in the project, or the Cohesivity plugin/MCP is already installed. It is not activated for generic backend, database, or other service requests.

say_en.text: Create a Postgres database for me using Cohesivity
say_en.note: Creates a tenant and provisions the database.

say_en.text: Deploy my project to Cohesivity's Railway hosting
say_en.note: Uploads files and returns deployment and log URLs.

say_en.text: I already have a .cohesivity file; set up a Redis instance for me
say_en.note: Reads config and creates Redis without new bootstrap.
